title: The Passive Voice for Formal Reporting
summary: إزاي تكتب الخبر بشكل رسمي بالمبني للمجهول (was discovered / has been found / will be revealed / It is believed that…) في الـ News Report.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: In the **passive voice**, the action or the thing that receives the action becomes the subject: **A royal tomb was discovered in Luxor.** We use it in **news reports** and formal writing when the action is more important than the person who did it.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن **المبني للمجهول** (the passive voice). يعني بدل ما نقول «**العلماء اكتشفوا** مقبرة»، نقول «**مقبرة اتكشفت**». الاهتمام هنا بـ **الحاجة اللي حصلت** مش بمين عملها.

في الكتاب الدرس ده في **Unit 3: Echoes of the Past**، Lesson 3.4 (**Social Media and Historical Events**)، في الـ **Writing Task: News Report** (صفحة 98). الـ checklist بتاعة الكتاب بتقول بالحرف: **I use the passive voice for formal reporting**، وأمثلة الكتاب: A royal tomb **was discovered** in Luxor this week / Experts say more details **will be revealed**. وبيرجع في **Consolidation Review B**: The inscriptions **were translated** by experts.
الفكرة ببساطة: مين المهم؟

text: Active: the **doer** is the subject. Passive: the **receiver** (the object of the active sentence) is the subject. The doer can be added with **by**, or left out.

blocks.text: بص على الجملتين دول:

items.en: **Archaeologists discovered** a royal tomb in Luxor.
**A royal tomb was discovered** in Luxor (by archaeologists).
items.ar: Passive (مبني للمجهول): المفعول (a royal tomb) بقى في الأول، والفاعل ممكن نذكره بعد **by** أو نشيله خالص.

blocks.text: في الأخبار، القارئ عايز يعرف **إيه اللي اتكشف** مش اسم كل عامل في الحفر. علشان كده الـ passive بيخلي الخبر **رسمي (formal)** و**موضوعي (objective)** و**مركز على الحدث**.
خطوات التحويل من active لـ passive في 4 خطوات:

items: هات **المفعول** (اللي وقع عليه الفعل) وحطه **في الأول**.
حط **be** في **نفس زمن** الفعل الأصلي (is / was / has been / will be…) واعمله يتفق مع الفاعل الجديد (مفرد ولا جمع).
حط الفعل الأصلي في **التصريف التالت (past participle = V3)**: discover ← discovered، find ← found، write ← written.
لو الفاعل مهم ضيفه بعد **by**، لو مش مهم أو مش معروف **شيله**.

blocks.text: جدول الـ Passive في كل الأزمنة

text: Passive = **be** (in the correct tense) + **past participle**. Only the form of **be** changes.

rows: modal (can / must / should / may) + be + p.p.

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ
items: الـ passive = **be + V3**. الـ be هي اللي بتشيل الزمن، والـ V3 ثابتة متتغيرش.
بعد **will / can / must / should / may** دايمًا **be** (من غير s): will **be** revealed.
بعد **has / have / had** دايمًا **been**: has **been** discovered.

blocks.text: ليه الـ Passive في الأخبار والتقارير الرسمية؟

text: We use the passive in formal reporting when: (1) the doer is **unknown**, (2) the doer is **obvious or not important**, (3) we want to keep the focus on the **event or object**, and (4) we want to sound **objective**.

rows: طبيعي إن اللي بيحفر هم الأثريين
A royal tomb **was discovered** in Luxor this week.
الكاتب مش بيدخّل نفسه في الكلام
It **has been announced** that the site will open soon.

blocks.text: ولاحظ كمان: الـ **headline** (العنوان) في الأخبار بيشيل الـ be خالص علشان يبقى قصير: **Ancient Tomb Discovered in Luxor** = An ancient tomb **has been / was** discovered in Luxor. ده مسموح في العنوان بس، مش جوه الخبر.
الـ Reporting Passive: It is believed that…

text: Formal reports often use reporting verbs in the passive: **It is believed / said / reported / thought / estimated that …**, or **The tomb is believed to be …** / **is thought to have been …**

blocks.text: ده أهم جزء في «formal reporting». لما الصحفي ينقل كلام أو رأي الخبراء من غير ما يقول «أنا شايف»، بيستخدم الأفعال دي: **believe, think, say, report, estimate, know, expect, announce, confirm**. وفيه شكلين:

rows: It is / was / has been + p.p. + that + جملة
**It is believed that** the tomb belongs to a royal princess.
الحاجة + is / are + p.p. + to be / to have + p.p.
The tomb **is believed to belong** to a royal princess.
is thought + **to have been / to have + p.p.**
The papyrus **is thought to have been written** 4,500 years ago.

items.en: **It is estimated that** the GEM will receive millions of visitors every year.
items.ar: بيقدّروا إن… (من غير ما نقول مين قدّر).

items.en: **It has been confirmed that** the statue is genuine.
The city **is said to have been** an important port in ancient times.
items.ar: بيقولوا إن المدينة كانت ميناء مهم زمان. to have been لأن الكلام عن الماضي.

items.en: The coins **are thought to date** from the Ptolemaic period.
items.ar: بيعتقدوا إن العملات راجعة للعصر البطلمي.

blocks.text: أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة
الأمثلة دي عن الاكتشافات الأثرية، المتاحف، ونشر الأخبار على السوشيال ميديا.

items.en: A royal tomb **was discovered** in Luxor this week.
items.ar: مقبرة ملكية اتكشفت في الأقصر الأسبوع ده. ده الـ lead بتاع الخبر (What + Where + When).

items.en: The discovery **was announced** by the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities.
items.ar: الاكتشاف اتعلن بواسطة وزارة السياحة والآثار. ذكرنا الفاعل بـ by لأنه مهم (مصدر رسمي).

items.en: Dozens of statues **have been found** under the water near Alexandria.
items.ar: عشرات التماثيل اتلاقت تحت المية قرب إسكندرية. present perfect passive.

items.en: The fragile papyrus **is being examined** in a special laboratory.
items.ar: البردية الضعيفة بيتم فحصها دلوقتي في معمل خاص. present continuous passive.

items.en: More details **will be revealed** next month.
items.ar: تفاصيل أكتر هتتكشف الشهر الجاي. future passive. ده الـ closing في مثال الكتاب.
الآثار لازم يتم التعامل معاها بحرص. modal passive.

items.en: In the past, discoveries **were reported** slowly in newspapers.
items.ar: زمان الاكتشافات كانت بتتنشر ببطء في الجرايد. ده الـ background في الخبر.

items.en: Today, photos of the site **are shared** online within minutes.
items.ar: النهارده صور الموقع بتتنشر أونلاين في دقايق.

items.en: The tomb **had been robbed** before it was found.
items.ar: المقبرة كانت اتسرقت قبل ما يلاقوها. past perfect passive: حاجة حصلت قبل حاجة في الماضي.

blocks.text: إزاي تستخدمه في الـ News Report

text: The book's news report has five parts: **Headline – Lead – Details – Background – Closing**. The passive fits naturally in every part.

rows: An ancient papyrus **was discovered** in Kafr El-Sheikh on Sunday.
مين اكتشفه، إيه هو، ليه مهم
It **was found** by a team of Egyptian archaeologists. It **is believed to be** over 2,000 years old.
In the past, such discoveries **were shared** only in academic journals.
Experts say the papyrus **will be displayed** at the GEM next year.

blocks.text: نموذج قصير (مش كامل، علشان تشوف الـ passive جوه خبر حقيقي):

blocks.title: Model news report (extract)
blocks.task: Write a short news report about an underwater discovery near Alexandria.
text: Three granite statues **were discovered** under the sea near Alexandria last Tuesday. The statues **were found** by a team of Egyptian divers at a depth of eight metres. They **are believed to have stood** at the entrance to an ancient temple.

In the past, news of such finds **was published** weeks later. This time, photos **were shared** online within hours. The statues **will be cleaned** and studied before they **are displayed** to the public.
notes: **العنوان**: قصير ومن غير be (Found = were found).
**الـ Lead**: إيه + فين + إمتى بالـ passive (were discovered … near Alexandria last Tuesday).
**التفاصيل**: ذكرنا الفاعل بعد **by** لأن الغواصين المصريين جزء من الخبر.
الـ **reporting passive** (are believed to have stood) بيخلي الخبر موضوعي.
**الخلفية والنهاية**: passive في الماضي (was published) وفي المستقبل (will be cleaned).

blocks.text: لاحظ: الكاتب ما قالش «أنا» ولا «إحنا»، وكل التركيز على **التماثيل والاكتشاف**. وده بالظبط معنى formal reporting.
إمتى منستخدمش الـ Passive؟

text: Only **transitive** verbs (verbs with an object) can be passive. Verbs like **happen, arrive, die, appear, disappear, exist** have no passive form.

blocks.text: الفعل لازم يكون ليه **مفعول** علشان يتعمل passive. أفعال زي **happen / arrive / disappear / appear / die / exist** مش بيبقى ليها مفعول، فمينفعش تتحول:

items.en: ✗ The accident **was happened** near the temple. ← ✓ The accident **happened** near the temple.
✗ Many old posts **were disappeared**. ← ✓ Many old posts **disappeared**.

blocks.text: وكمان متكترش من الـ passive لو الفاعل مهم جدًا للقصة. مثلًا: **Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamun's tomb.** هنا اسم Carter جزء من الخبر، فـ active أوضح (أو passive مع by).

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ The inscriptions **was** translated. ← ✓ The inscriptions **were** translated. (inscriptions جمع)
✗ The inscriptions were **translate**. ← ✓ were **translated**. (لازم V3)
✗ The inscriptions **have translating**. ← ✓ **have been translated**. (Review B)
✗ The tomb **discovered** last week. ← ✓ The tomb **was discovered** last week. (من غير be الجملة بقت active غلط، إلا في العنوان)
✗ More details will **revealed**. ← ✓ will **be revealed**.
✗ A statue has **be** found. ← ✓ has **been** found.
✗ The site was visited **from** thousands of tourists. ← ✓ **by** thousands of tourists.
✗ It **believes** that the coins are Roman. ← ✓ It **is believed** that the coins are Roman.

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: لو الفاعل في الجملة **حاجة** (tomb, statue, papyrus) والحاجة دي مش ممكن تعمل الفعل بنفسها ← غالبًا **passive**.
اتأكد من 3 حاجات: **be** في الزمن الصح، **be** متفقة مع الفاعل (was / were)، والفعل **V3**.
لو فيه **by + شخص** بعد الفراغ ← passive أكيد.
كلمات الزمن بتحدد الـ be: yesterday / last week ← was / were · since / already ← has / have been · next month / soon ← will be.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

text: a. The statues was found near the harbour.
b. The statues were find near the harbour.
c. The statues were found near the harbour.
d. The statues have finding near the harbour.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c.** statues جمع = were، والفعل find تصريفه التالت found.
**2) Write the correct form of the verb between brackets.**

text: The new hall (open) by the Prime Minister next week.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** **will be opened** — next week = مستقبل، والقاعة مش بتفتح نفسها، فـ passive.
**3) Rewrite the sentence in the passive.**

text: The team has photographed every wall of the tomb.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** Every wall of the tomb **has been photographed** (by the team). — has + been + V3، ومش لازم نذكر the team.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. A rare golden ring ______ in Saqqara last month.
a. discovered  b. was discovered  c. has discovered  d. is discovering
items.a: **b. was discovered** — last month = ماضي بسيط، والخاتم مش بيكتشف نفسه.

items.q:
2. The results of the study ______ next year.
a. will publish  b. will be publish  c. will be published  d. are publishing
items.a: **c. will be published** — will + be + V3.

items.q:
3. Hundreds of artefacts ______ to the GEM since 2020.
a. have been moved  b. has been moved  c. were moved  d. have moved
items.a: **a. have been moved** — since = present perfect، وartefacts جمع = have.

items.q:
4. The old map is very delicate and must ______ carefully.
a. handle  b. be handled  c. handled  d. be handling
items.a: **b. be handled** — modal + be + V3.

items.q:
5. ______ that the temple was built for the god Amun.
a. It believes  b. It is believed  c. It was believing  d. They are believed
items.a: **b. It is believed** — reporting passive: It is believed that…

items.q:
6. The mask ______ when we arrived, so we couldn't see it.
a. was being cleaned  b. is cleaned  c. was cleaning  d. has cleaned
items.a: **a. was being cleaned** — كان بيتنضف وقت ما وصلنا (past continuous passive).

items.q:
7. The ancient city ______ to have been destroyed by an earthquake.
a. thinks  b. is thought  c. is thinking  d. thought
items.a: **b. is thought** — The city is thought to have been… (بيعتقدوا إنها اتدمرت).

items.q:
8. The old photograph was shared ______ thousands of users.
a. from  b. with  c. by  d. of
items.a: **c. by** — الفاعل في الـ passive بييجي بعد by.

blocks.text: **B. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
9. a. The coins were cleaned by students.
b. The coins was cleaned by students.
c. The coins were clean by students.
d. The coins have cleaning by students.
items.a: **a** — coins جمع = were + V3 (cleaned).

items.q:
10. a. The accident was happened near the excavation site.
b. The accident happened near the excavation site.
c. The accident has been happened near the excavation site.
d. The accident is happened near the excavation site.
items.a: **b** — happen مالهاش passive.

items.q:
11. a. A new tomb has be found in Aswan.
b. A new tomb has been find in Aswan.
c. A new tomb has been found in Aswan.
d. A new tomb have been found in Aswan.
items.a: **c** — tomb مفرد = has + been + found.

items.q:
12. a. More details will reveal soon.
b. More details will be revealing soon.
c. More details will be revealed soon.
d. More details will revealed soon.
items.a: **c** — will + be + V3.

blocks.text: **C. Write the correct form of the verbs between brackets (active or passive).**

items.q: 13. The Rosetta Stone (find) in 1799 near the city of Rashid.
items.a: **was found** — حدث في الماضي، والحجر اتلاقى.

items.q: 14. Today, many historical posts (share) on social media every minute.
items.a: **are shared** — present simple passive (حاجة بتحصل دايمًا).

items.q: 15. At the moment, the statue (restore) by a team of experts.
items.a: **is being restored** — at the moment = present continuous passive.

items.q: 16. Archaeologists (work) at the site since 2023.
items.a: **have worked / have been working** — هنا active لأن archaeologists هم اللي بيشتغلوا، وwork مالهاش مفعول.

items.q: 17. The tomb (rob) before the archaeologists arrived.
items.a: **had been robbed** — حصل قبل حدث تاني في الماضي = past perfect passive.

items.q: 18. It (report) that the museum will open a new children's gallery.
items.a: **is reported / has been reported** — reporting passive.

blocks.text: **D. Rewrite in the passive. Then write.**

items.q: 19. Rewrite in the passive: Experts examine the coins in a laboratory.
items.a: The coins **are examined** in a laboratory (by experts). — present simple، coins جمع = are.

items.q: 20. Rewrite in the passive: The ministry will announce the discovery tomorrow.
items.a: The discovery **will be announced** (by the ministry) tomorrow.

items.q: 21. Rewrite in the passive: Someone has deleted the original video.
items.a: The original video **has been deleted**. — someone مش معروف، فبنشيله خالص.

items.q: 22. Rewrite starting with the words given: People believe that the statue is 3,000 years old. → The statue …
items.a: The statue **is believed to be** 3,000 years old. — ولو عايز It: **It is believed that** the statue is 3,000 years old.

items.q: 23. Find and correct the mistake: The new gallery was visit by 5,000 students last week.
items.a: visit ← **visited**: was **visited**. — لازم V3.

items.q: 24. Write a headline and a lead (What + Where + When) for a news report about a papyrus found in the Delta.
items.a: مثال: **Ancient Papyrus Found in the Delta** / A 2,000-year-old papyrus **was discovered** in Kafr El-Sheikh on Monday morning. — العنوان من غير be، والـ lead فيه passive + فين + إمتى.

items.q: 25. Write THREE sentences for the Details and Closing parts of the same report. Use a different passive form in each.
items.a: مثال: The papyrus **was found** by a team of local archaeologists. It **is thought to contain** a list of temple offerings. It **will be displayed** at the GEM after it **has been restored**. — past simple / reporting passive / future + present perfect passive.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: Passive = **be (في الزمن الصح) + V3**: is found / was found / has been found / will be found / must be found.
بنستخدمه في الأخبار لما الحدث أهم من الفاعل، أو الفاعل مش معروف، وعلشان الكلام يبقى **رسمي وموضوعي**.
الفاعل لو مهم ييجي بعد **by**، لو مش مهم نشيله.
Reporting passive: **It is believed / reported / estimated that…** و **The tomb is thought to be / to have been…**
أفعال زي happen / disappear / arrive **مالهاش passive**، والعنوان بس هو اللي بيشيل be.
